title: ProductEventEnvelopeV1
description: Canonical ProductEvent envelope (TAVONEL Cinematic Compilation Replay Master Spec v2.0 §9.4). One vocabulary for the cinematic landing and the live product. Per-type payload shapes are separate payload contracts; the envelope only guarantees framing, identity, ordering and mode.

schema_version.description: Pinned while the v1 envelope is current; a mismatch must fail validation, never fall through.

event_id.description: Globally unique id of this single frame, e.g. 'evt-impact-0001'.

event_type.description: §9.3 lists A (names already produced by akc_cir.collection_events) and B (client proposal). The §9.3 'C' candidates are deliberately absent until a backend producer or a DERIVED beat exists.

sequence.description: Monotonic per scope (§9.6). Sequence values from different scopes are different counter spaces and must never be compared.

monotonic_offset_ms.description: Optional stream-relative offset used by deterministic replay; absent on frames that carry only wall-clock time.

mode.description: 'demo' = replayed fixture data, 'live' = real backend frame. A live source cannot emit 'demo'.

scope.description: Discriminated union on 'kind': which backend plane's identity the event follows.

payload.description: Opaque at the envelope level ('unknown' in §9.4); each event_type carries its own payload contract validated elsewhere.
